title: Democratizing Ethical Assessment of Natural Language Generation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Triggering language generation models with prompts associated with different religious ideologies, scoring the generated responses for attributes like toxicity, profanity, threat, and insult using Perspective API, and comparing the distribution and demographic parity of these scores across the religious groups.
